title: Prototypical Residual Networks for Anomaly Detection and Localization (PRN)
mechanism: Multi-scale residual prototypes between anomalous and normal features plus multi-size self-attention, trained with a few real anomalies and generated seen / unseen-style anomalies.
adaptation: Supervised-AD benchmark row: 478 labelled cells as seen anomalies, binary defect target; port its anomaly generators to EL dark lines and blobs. Overlaps the WeakREST arm; run only if that arm works.
evidence: R: beats unsupervised and supervised methods on MVTec AD plus 3 more datasets.
min_experiment: Benchmark row; if used as a member, same kill as DeSTSeg (relR@2 gain < +0.02).
